components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The ink pill; one per section, always the install guide.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink-btn, #111315); color: var(--on-ink, #ffffff); font: 600 16px/1 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.005em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out, transform 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-btn-hover, #2a2d31); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong, #111315); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: The secondary destination beside the primary: ink text, underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 46px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--text-strong, #111315); font: 600 16px/1 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.005em; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong, #111315); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky translucent bar: wordmark left, links and the theme control right.
components.html:
badil
Install guideGitHub
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 64px; padding: 0 32px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg, #fff) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(10px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e5e8); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4em; color: var(--text-strong, #111315); font-size: 19px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 24px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-links a { color: var(--text, #4b5158); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text-strong, #111315); } .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong, #111315); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Theme Control
components.description: System, Light, Dark: three icon buttons in a hairline pill; the pressed one sits on the code well.
components.css: .ds-theme { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e5e8); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-theme-btn { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: var(--text-faint, #6b7178); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease-out, background-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-theme-btn:hover { color: var(--text-strong, #111315); } .ds-theme-btn[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--code, #f1f2f4); color: var(--text-strong, #111315); } .ds-theme-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong, #111315); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Green pill for a label or live state; amber code for a pinned SHA.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0a7a3a) 12%, transparent); color: var(--accent, #0a7a3a); font: 600 12px/20px 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pin { padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--pin-soft, #fdf1d8); color: var(--pin, #8a5300); font: 12.5px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; }

components.name: File Card
components.description: A file as it lands in the gitops repo: canvas path bar over mono code, 10px hairline panel.
components.css: .ds-file { margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e5e8); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--panel, #fff); overflow: hidden; } .ds-file-path { padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e5e8); background: var(--canvas, #f6f7f8); color: var(--text, #4b5158); font: 12.5px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; } .ds-file-code { margin: 0; padding: 14px; color: var(--text-strong, #111315); font: 11.5px/1.7 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; }

components.name: Evidence Card
components.description: A small recreation of the artifact that proves a claim, above its term and description.
components.css: .ds-evidence { display: grid; align-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 104px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e5e8); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--panel, #fff); color: var(--text, #4b5158); font: 13.5px 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-strong { color: var(--text-strong, #111315); font-weight: 600; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #0a7a3a); } .ds-ok { color: var(--accent, #0a7a3a); }

components.name: Hero Panel
components.description: The frame around the live loop at 1148px and up; the page's only shadow. Below that width the loop sits unframed on the ground.
components.css: .ds-hero-panel { padding: 28px 0; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e5e8); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--panel, #fff); box-shadow: var(--panel-shadow, 0 1px 2px rgba(16,20,24,0.04), 0 24px 48px -28px rgba(16,20,24,0.22)); } .ds-hero-stage { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 160px; color: var(--text-faint, #6b7178); font: 15px 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } @media (max-width: 1147px) { .ds-hero-panel { padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: none; box-shadow: none; } }

narrative.overview:
badil's site is a product page at the craft of the infrastructure tools its readers already trust: white ground, ink type, hairline borders, and the product itself shown at real scale. The page is the quiet frame; the illustrations (the live preview loop and the pull request still) are where the product's colour and detail live. Nothing on the page dresses up as a terminal or a dashboard: there is no mono costume, no grid background, no numbered panels.

Density is generous. Sections breathe on a large vertical rhythm, one idea per section, with a heading and its lead on the left and the evidence on the right. Depth is almost absent: everything is flat and separated by 1px hairlines, with one soft shadow reserved for the product panel in the hero.

Light and dark are equal citizens. Light is neutral gray on white; dark is green-tinted near-black, so the terminal green reads as native to the ground. A three-way theme control (System, Light, Dark) switches the page and every illustration together.
keyCharacteristics: White ground (dark: green-tinted near-black), ink text, 1px hairlines.
One green, meaning live/healthy/ready; one amber, meaning a pinned commit.
One face, Schibsted Grotesk, for all text; the system mono for code only.
Pill buttons and chips, 10px panels, a 16px stage frame.
Flat everywhere except the hero's product panel.

rules.name: The Product Owns the Green Rule
rules.body: Green is a status, not a brand fill. It appears where the product would show it (ready, healthy, labelled, linked) and on the mark's dashed twin (the preview, the double of production); it never fills a button, a section or a heading.

rules.name: The Amber Means Pinned Rule
rules.body: Amber marks a pinned commit and nothing else. No warnings, no highlights.

rules.name: The Mono Is Code Rule
rules.body: Mono is set only on text that is literally code or a git identifier. Headings, labels and UI chrome are always in the grotesk.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The hero's product panel carries the page's only shadow. Every other surface is flat, bordered by a hairline.

dos: Do keep the page on paper/night with hairline (`#e3e5e8` / `#232823`) borders and let the illustrations carry the colour.
Do use green only for live, healthy, ready, labelled or linked states, and amber only for pinned commits.
Do use the ink pill for the single primary action and a quiet text link beside it.
Do set every text in Schibsted Grotesk and reserve mono for code, paths and SHAs.
Do switch the page and every illustration together when the theme changes.
donts: Don't add a second shadow; the hero product panel owns the only one.
Don't fill buttons, sections or headings with green.
Don't put eyebrows or kickers above headings, grid backgrounds, numbered decorative panels, or mono-set UI chrome.
Don't frame the loop below 1148px; the smaller designs sit on the page ground.
